description_en: Authorizes assets for a user. After the authorization, the user can use Bastionhost to perform O&M operations on the authorized assets
description_zh: 当您新建用户之后，您需要为该用户授权资产。授权后该用户才可以使用堡垒机运维已授权的资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost attach-host-accounts-to-user --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-id 1 --hosts HostId_:_1_,_HostId_:_2_,_HostAccountIds_:_1_,_2_,_3_,_HostId_:_3_,_HostAccountIds_:_4_,_5_,_6_,_HostId_:_4_,_HostAccountIds_:_9_,_8_,_7 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachHostAccountsToUser

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance to which the user to be granted authorization for hosts and host accounts belongs.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance where the user to be authorized for hosts and host accounts resides.
For the mappings between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户所在堡垒机的区域ID。
区域ID和区域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the user to whom you want to authorize hosts and host accounts.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html operation to query the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要授权主机和主机账户的用户ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204522.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the hosts and host accounts to be authorized for the user. You can specify up to 10 host IDs, and up to 9 host account IDs for each host. If you do not specify host account IDs, only the hosts are authorized for the user. For more information about the structure of this parameter, see the Hosts parameter structure description in the request parameters section.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html operation to query host IDs and call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html operation to query host account IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要为用户授权的主机ID和主机账户ID。最多支持设置10个主机ID，每个主机最多支持设置9个主机账户ID。您可以不设置主机账户ID，不设置主机账户ID表示仅为用户授权主机。该参数的具体结构请参考请求参数列表下的Hosts参数结构说明。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200665.html接口获取主机ID，调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/204372.html接口获取主机账户ID
parameters.name: hosts
